related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

observation.source_interface: MNCS Control Environment RPC and Environment capability-intelligence projection

request.captured_operation_scope: explicitly allowlisted read-only Environment RPC operations

captured_fields: Control grant and optional process identity
Environment, campaign, work intent, repository, branch and head context
Control dispatch elapsed time including session-lock wait
outcome.redaction: Raw request arguments and response values are not copied into the observation.
outcome.environment_correlation: The projection accepts only events whose authenticated principal, Environment, campaign and work-intent match the selected session; rejected event records are counted and omitted.

boundedness.store_tail_payloads_materialized: only the selected newest event window; generation binding metadata is still scanned

outcome.implementation_status: committed and targeted tests passed on isolated Environment and Control campaign branches
outcome.current_service_status: the live service has not loaded these branch commits; no production capture is claimed
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: implementation-and-targeted-verification-complete; production adoption and recurring effect not assessed

improvement_relation.basis: Control emits bounded authenticated read-operation outcomes and Environment verifies session binding, projects source-event references and discloses unavailable measures. Targeted tests cover redaction, context binding, projection, retry and bounded Store-tail reads.
improvement_relation.effectiveness_assessment: production uptake and reduction in the observed limitation remain unassessed
not_measured: whether the updated services are deployed to live sessions
